content: WhatsApp _chat.txt format: plain UTF-8, one msg/line '<ts> - <sender>: <msg>'. Timestamp is locale-dependent: DD/MM/YYYY 24h (EU) vs M/D/YY h:mm PM (US); separators vary (-/. ), optional brackets. Multi-line msgs: only first line has timestamp, continuation lines lack it. Special lines: <Media omitted> (LOCALIZED: e.g. French 'Média absent', German 'Medien ausgeschlossen'), 'This message was deleted', system events (no sender/colon) like 'X added Y', group renames, and the E2E encryption notice (always 2nd line, filter out). NOT in file: reactions, reply context, read receipts. Two top gotchas: regional date format + multi-line continuation. Match structurally, not by string on 'Media omitted'.
